messages:
frank-sales: Heads-up  Kyoto Labs wants to start a 10-day POC but procurement is holding staging until we provide: SOC 2 artifacts (summary or bridge), ISO 27001 cert, a signed pen-test attestation, and confirmation of EU residency. Can we turn these around today?

meera-se: I can grab the SOC2 bridge + control mapping excerpt. Question: do they need the full report or will the redacted bridge suffice for procurement?

derek-security: Procurement usually accepts the SOC2 bridge + redacted control matrix for POCs. Full SOC2 report requires an NDA + secure transfer. We can also provide the ISO certificate PDF.

talia-ps: They also want a pen-test attestation on letterhead with a named signer for vendor validation. Who can sign and how quickly can we get it?

derek-security: I can sign as Director of Security today. Standard attestation text: "Redwood Inference attests a third-party penetration test was completed on YYYY-MM and no critical open findings existed at time of reporting." We don't publish raw findings.

frank-sales: Procurement asked about KMS separation and whether auditors can run a brief external scan against the staging endpoint. Are ad-hoc scans allowed?

meera-se: External scans by their vendor are allowed but must be pre-authorised and scoped. For live auditor SSO access we'd need signed access terms and ~5 business days to provision. KMS separation (customer-managed keys) requires Dedicated/Private and ~72h to set up.

artifacts-bot: action: presigned S3 upload link created (expires 7 days)  DM'd to frank-sales (link hidden).

frank-sales: Also flag: Kyoto asked whether we can provide a one-time POC billing credit if they commit to a paid pilot. That may clear procurement. Any guidance on discounts for short reserved capacity?

talia-ps: For 2-week reserved capacity we typically offer a small pilot credit or reduced commit rate depending on ARR target. I'll run numbers and propose a pilot discount matrix tomorrow.

meera-se: Next steps: 1) derek upload signed pen-test attestation to presigned link TODAY, 2) meera upload SOC2 bridge + ISO cert TODAY, 3) talia send POC pricing/credit proposal TOMORROW, 4) frank reply to procurement with timeline (TODAY).

derek-security: Will attach signed attestation and include contact details.

meera-se: Uploading SOC2 bridge + ISO cert now. Reminder: redact customer/org names per guidance.

frank-sales: Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
